cohort: Women with excessive menstrual bleeding after abortion or LSCS at Mallareddy Nrayana Hospital, Hyderabad, Telangana, India, between December 2014 and February 2020.
finding: Uterine artery embolization (UAE) was a minimally invasive and effective treatment for uterine AVMs, restoring menstruation in all 10 women treated.
followup_time: Variable, up to 5 months post-procedure for menstrual function recovery
